name: Akash
author: akash contributors
description: Akash (อากาศ, 'sky/ether') — live weather radar and Copernicus CAMS air quality on one map in the Omarchy bar, with storm and air-quality alerts. No account, no API key.

barWidget.description: Akash (อากาศ) — weather radar plus CAMS air quality, pollen and UV on one map, with optional storm and air-quality alerts.

schema.label: Open panel on
schema.description: Which view the panel shows each time it opens — Radar by default, or your last-used chip. Allergens outside Europe falls back to Air quality.

schema.label: Storm alerts
schema.description: Notify when rain or a storm is forecast to reach you from within the alert radius. Also toggleable from the panel.

schema.label: Air quality alerts
schema.description: Notify when the tracked air-quality layer reaches the chosen band at your location, now or in the next few forecast hours. Also toggleable from the panel.

schema.label: Air quality threshold
schema.description: Minimum EEA air-quality band worth a notification, on the tracked layer (default PM2.5). Cut-offs are per species, so the band means the right concentration whatever the layer.

schema.label: Alert radius (km)
schema.description: How far out to watch, and with it how far ahead to look: storms travel 40-60 km/h, so 100 km is roughly two hours of warning. The panel offers the common values; any step of 25 works here.

schema.label: Alert threshold
schema.description: Minimum forecast rain rate worth a notification. Moderate or heavier arriving into an unstable airmass counts one band up, so a storm crosses the threshold sooner than steady rain of the same rate.

schema.label: Colour scheme
schema.description: Radar palette. NEXRAD Level III matches what most broadcast meteorologists show.

schema.label: Default zoom
schema.description: Zoom the map opens at. Past level 7 the ground keeps sharpening while the radar is scaled up, since that is where the radar data runs out.

schema.label: Smooth radar
schema.description: Blend the radar image instead of showing hard pixel edges.

schema.label: Show status text in bar
schema.description: Print the outlook next to the bar icon: what is approaching, and when. Requires storm alerts to be on, since what it prints is their forecast.
